item.jaymospowers.plate_carrier.lore: Worn on Los Perrito's east bridge, and taken off the fallen with their guns.
item.jaymospowers.tracer_round.hint: Right-click onto a loaded future gun: its next shots streak
item.jaymospowers.tracer_round.lore: Every fourth round burns bright, so the dead can follow their own fire through Los Perrito's endless night.
item.jaymospowers.magazine.hint: Right-click rounds onto it to load it; right-click it onto its gun to swap
item.jaymospowers.magazine.lore: A future gunner counts every magazine. A dropped gun with one still in it is a gift; an empty gun is just a heavy club.
